title: Examining the Behavior of LLM Architectures Within the Framework of Standardized National Exams in Brazil

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Jensen-Shannon distance between LLM multiple-choice answer probability distributions and the answer distributions of Brazilian students stratified by socioeconomic status (SES) levels on the ENEM standardized exam, as well as analyzing syntactic complexity and vocabulary differences between LLM-generated and human-written essays.
